phases.name: Single sign-on configuration and sign-in start

tasks.title: Read the provider configuration and expose what is enabled
tasks.description: readSsoProviders enables a provider only when both client id and secret are set, sanitises MICROSOFT_TENANT to one URL-safe segment, and listProviders returns id/label pairs only.

tasks.title: Start a sign-in with state, PKCE and a nonce
tasks.description: startSso fetches discovery, creates the PKCE pair, state and nonce, stores only the state hash with the verifier, nonce, validated redirect and a ten-minute expiry, and redirects with Cache-Control: no-store (safeRedirectPath for the redirect, 502 when the provider is unreachable).

phases.name: Callback, token verification and account resolution

tasks.title: Finish the round trip and map every failure to a fixed code
tasks.description: ssoCallback deletes the pending state first (single use), always exchanges the code with the PKCE verifier, and redirects to /login with one of the fixed SsoErrorCode values; the session token travels in the URL fragment of /sso/complete.

tasks.title: Verify ID tokens and decide which claims to trust
tasks.description: oidc.ts caches discovery and JWKS, accepts only RS256 keys from the discovered set, checks audience, expiry, iat, issuer (including Microsoft tenant templates), azp and nonce, and identityFromClaims applies the Google/Microsoft email trust rules.

tasks.title: Resolve, link or create the account
tasks.description: resolveSsoUser links by (provider, subject), requires a provider-verified email otherwise, links or creates a verified ssoOnly account with a random password, takes over an unverified account, and refuses a second identity of the same provider.

tasks.title: Send two-factor accounts to the challenge step
tasks.description: An SSO identity whose account has two-factor on receives a challenge in the fragment of the login page instead of a session, so both sign-in paths share one second step.

tasks.title: Implement TOTP on Node crypto only
tasks.description: base32 encode/decode, HOTP/TOTP generation, a +/-1 step window, a comparison that visits every candidate step, a lastUsedStep replay guard and the otpauth URL builder.

tasks.title: Challenge, verify and lock the second step
tasks.description: createChallenge writes a hashed single-use nonce with a five-minute expiry and signs a separate-purpose JWT; completeTwoFactorLogin verifies the code or a recovery code with conditional writes, counts challenge attempts, deletes the challenge after five wrong codes and locks the account for fifteen minutes after repeated failures.

tasks.title: Wire the password step to the challenge
tasks.description: loginUser answers { twoFactorRequired: true, challenge } instead of a session when the account has two-factor on, and POST /api/auth/login/2fa completes it via completeTwoFactorLogin.

tasks.title: Expose the status and start a setup
tasks.description: getTwoFactorStatus reports enabled, enabledAt and recoveryCodesRemaining; setupTwoFactor returns a base32 secret and otpauth URL while storing the secret encrypted as pending, refusing when already on.

tasks.title: Enable with the password and a proving code
tasks.description: enableTwoFactor requires the password plus a valid code, stores the encrypted secret, records the proving step as used, drops the pending secret and returns ten recovery codes exactly once (conditional update so a second tab cannot win).

tasks.title: Accept and regenerate recovery codes
tasks.description: Recovery codes are generated from an alphabet without look-alike characters, hashed with bcrypt and consumed by a conditional pull; regeneration requires the password plus a current authenticator code and invalidates the previous codes.

tasks.title: Disable two-factor unless a workspace requires it
tasks.description: disableTwoFactor requires the password plus a code or a recovery code, refuses with TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED_BY_WORKSPACE while any workspace requires it, and clears every two-factor field and the open challenges.

tasks.title: List and unlink provider identities
tasks.description: listSsoMethods reports the linked providers, whether a password exists and which providers are configured; unlinkSsoMethod pulls one link and refuses the only method of a passwordless account with LAST_SIGN_IN_METHOD.

tasks.title: Generate tokens and store only a digest
tasks.description: generateApiToken returns tm_ plus 40 uniform base62 characters with an 8-character display prefix and a keyed PBKDF2-SHA256 digest; validateCreateToken checks the name, scope keys, scope subset, the ten-token cap and the expiry window.

tasks.title: List and create tokens without ever returning them again
tasks.description: listTokens projects an explicit field set that excludes the digest and shows only the caller's tokens; createToken returns the plain value once and records token.created.

tasks.title: Enforce the token's workspace and scopes on every request
tasks.description: protect dispatches tm_ tokens to authenticateApiToken (digest lookup, usable check, workspace route required, throttled lastUsedAt) and requirePermission adds the workspace and scope checks on top of the role's permissions.

tasks.title: Revoke a token
tasks.description: revokeToken lets the owner revoke their own token or a settings:manage holder revoke any token in the workspace, sets revokedAt and records token.revoked; revoked and expired tokens are refused on use.

tasks.title: Offer provider buttons and complete the hand-off
tasks.description: SsoButtons renders one button per configured provider and marks the pending sign-in per tab; SsoCompletePage reads the fragment once, clears it from the address bar and history, requires a sign-in started in this tab, loads the profile and stores the session.

tasks.title: Map server error codes to plain language
tasks.description: lib.ssoErrorMessage covers every SsoErrorCode plus not_started, unknown codes fall back to a generic message, and safeAppPath restricts the redirect to an in-app path.

tasks.title: Build the two-factor settings and recovery UI
tasks.description: TwoFactorCard, TwoFactorSetupDialog, RecoveryCodesDialog and the TwoFactorStep form, with sanitised code input, grouped secret display, normalised recovery codes and a downloadable recovery file.

tasks.title: Gate a workspace that requires two-factor
tasks.description: The axios client raises TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED_EVENT on a 403 with that code and TwoFactorRequiredGate shows a blocking screen with a link to Security settings; the workspace security card warns the admin before enabling the policy.

tasks.title: Build the developer token screens
tasks.description: DevelopersPage with useTokens, CreateTokenDialog, TokenList and SecretReveal: scopes limited by catalog.grantableScopes, read scopes preselected, and the secret shown once.

tasks.title: Unit test the pure modules
tasks.description: totp.test.ts, secretBox.test.ts, apiTokens.test.ts, oidc.test.ts and ssoRedirect.test.ts cover the RFC vectors, the encryption context binding, token format and digests, token verification and redirect safety.

tasks.title: Integration test the flows
tasks.description: sso.test.ts (a fake provider), twoFactor.test.ts and apiTokens.test.ts drive SSO sign-in, linking, the second step, recovery codes, the workspace policy and token use over HTTP against a real database.

tasks.title: Bound brute force at both steps
tasks.description: Both two-factor routes sit behind sensitiveLimiter, a challenge tolerates five wrong codes, and five consecutive failures set lockedUntil for fifteen minutes.

tasks.title: Keep secrets out of storage, logs and responses
tasks.description: secretBox for the shared secret, bcrypt for recovery codes, SHA-256 for state and challenge nonces, PBKDF2 for tokens, select: false on every secret field, a toJSON reduction of twoFactor, and logFailure that prints only the error name and message.

tasks.title: Require a real session for account endpoints
tasks.description: protect plus rejectApiToken on every /api/profile/2fa and /api/profile/sso route, and password confirmation before enabling, disabling or regenerating codes (CON-511).

tasks.title: Run the repository quality gates
tasks.description: pnpm --filter server typecheck && pnpm --filter server test, pnpm --filter client typecheck && pnpm --filter client test && pnpm --filter client lint, pnpm --filter client build, plus the browser checks on the sign-in, security and developers screens (CON-402, CON-703).
